title: Choose Stif's new world
question: Your pins hold for every card: matcha green leads, paper grain, hand-cut edges, warm and cool colours, more fun. The roll picked the world they live in. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Speckled stoneware
options.lineage: Hand-thrown tea bowls: speckled clay, oribe green glaze, persimmon and cobalt glazes, the potter's seal
options.thesis: Every note is a glazed piece, every collection a glaze, and Claude is the kiln that fires each link into its bowl.
materials: ash-white glaze cards with hand-thrown rims
options.viewport: Speckled clay ground; a glazed search bowl; collections as a row of glaze-dipped pebbles; two columns of ash-glazed cards with uneven rims; a persimmon capture button.
options.risk: Can read zen and quiet: the fun has to come from glaze colour, drips and the wobble, never from ornament.

raised.raise: State is hand-marked: selection is a brushed ring around the piece, done is a brush strike and the potter's seal, never a fade alone.
Collections show their extent: each pebble in the strip carries its count, the fullest first after the pinned ones.
Figures obey one rule everywhere: prices and counts in tabular figures, aligned in one column inside a collection.
One fixed ramp of mark sizes (44, 28, 20) wherever a collection appears, so its size always means the same thing.
Each screen gives one piece the room: the board's capture bowl, a collection's header, a link's photo.

options.label: Papiers découpés
options.lineage: Matisse's cut-outs: gouache-painted sheets cut with scissors and pinned to the studio wall
options.thesis: Every note is a hand-cut sheet pinned to a warm wall, every collection a cut-out emblem, and Claude snips each link into place.
materials: a cut-out emblem per collection (leaf, star, wave, wedge)
options.viewport: A warm paper wall; cut-out emblems for each collection across the top; two columns of cut sheets with uneven edges; a matcha leaf as the capture button.
options.risk: Strong colour can get loud at a hundred notes: emblems carry the colour, sheets stay pale.

options.label: Garden guide map
options.lineage: A zoo and gardens guide map: swelling lobes of flat colour, capsule signs, a coastline that does the dividing
options.thesis: Your collections are areas on a guide map; a shared link walks the path and settles in its area, its photo cropped to the area's shape.
materials: flat colour lobes (grained, per your pin)
capsule controls in coral, sun, pond and lilac
options.viewport: A matcha lobe swelling across the top holding search and the collection capsules; the cream board below; blob-cropped photos on cards.
options.case: Wins on fun and on warm and cool colour; ties on clarity, since a map of areas suits collections better than free notes.
options.risk: A map again: after the metro it can feel like a second transit diagram unless the lobes always mean a collection.

options.label: Convention circle catalog
options.lineage: Newsprint fan-convention catalogs: stamp-sized drawings in a numbered grid, circled in biro
options.thesis: The board as a catalog page of tiny cells, the ones you care about circled by hand.
options.viewport: A dense grid of thumbnail cells with codes.
options.case: Single black ink drops matcha and the warm and cool colours you asked for.
options.kept: Hand-marked state: a brushed ring for selected, a brush strike for done.
options.risk: Too dense and too grey for daily notes.

options.label: Boxed-software manual
options.lineage: Tabbed reference manuals with acetate leaves over coloured divider boards
options.thesis: Collections as divider tabs down the edge, their height set by how much they hold.
options.viewport: A tab rail with the open section as the page.
options.case: Hard 90 ms steps and no grain fight the soft, hand-made feel you pinned.
options.kept: Collections show their extent: counts on every collection mark.
options.risk: Reads like documentation, not like a place you want to open.

options.label: Data-sublime field
options.lineage: Black and white barcode fields and sine lattices
options.thesis: Notes as columns in a pure black and white data field.
options.case: Colder than the metro, the exact opposite of the brief.
options.kept: One rule applied totally: tabular figures for every price and count.

options.label: Star atlas
options.lineage: Celestial charts: magnitude dots on a navy sphere
options.thesis: Notes as stars sized by importance.
options.case: Navy night is the cold feeling you want gone.
options.kept: A fixed size ramp: a collection mark is always 44, 28 or 20.

options.label: Factory records sleeve
options.lineage: Matte black catalogue sleeves with coded colour strips
options.thesis: Every note a catalogue number on black.
options.case: Black and coded: neither warm nor clear.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Keep's arrangement in Material 3, themed matcha, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Search bar, masonry of pastel cards, bottom bar and FAB, as Keep does it.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Keep by design, which is what you asked to leave.
